note.description: Header text. Trimmed at runtime, then limited to 128 Unicode code points; control characters are rejected. Empty means no note.

reference.description: Show the target palette's nominal colors before the candidates.

colors.description: Candidate tiles in display order; omit to use the built-in set. Colors must be unique, compared case-insensitively at runtime.

label.description: Trimmed at runtime, then limited to 32 Unicode code points; control characters are rejected. Empty means no label.
